Params.Name: WaveAmplitude
Params.Label: Amplitude
Params.Description: Peak height of the wave displacement.

Params.Name: WaveFrequency
Params.Label: Frequency
Params.Description: Spatial frequency of the base wave. Higher values create denser, shorter waves.

Params.Name: WaveSpeed
Params.Label: Speed
Params.Description: Phase velocity of wave motion. Negative reverses direction.
